name: Loscy
description: A pixel-style personal site and blog with a desktop-inspired interface.

models.prompt: Build a quiet personal Hexo blog with a custom EJS theme that feels like a small pixel desktop: an entry loading screen, window-style inner pages for about/blog/project content, Unifont-based monochrome UI, a persistent bottom system bar with clock/music controls, and lightweight vanilla CSS/JS instead of a heavy framework.
